name: iroh-quic-tailnet-baseline
purpose: Measure a relay-free Iroh/QUIC endpoint pair over two hosts on the same tailnet and verify direct addressing, framed echo and reconnect
steps: Build the pinned iroh 1.4.1 probe from research/iroh-probe on both hosts
Bind the server endpoint to its tailnet IPv4 address with RelayMode::Disabled
Connect the macOS client to the server by EndpointId plus direct tailnet address
Echo bounded binary payloads on bidirectional QUIC streams
Close the connection and reconnect to measure setup cost
